variables.labels: 52 source skin-marker labels. Table 1 and Figure 1 of the paper describe placements. Index order is preserved.
variables.positions: Laboratory XYZ millimetres at 100 Hz. Source-processed trajectories, gap-filled and filtered. A missing point would serialize as null.
variables.plate: Original two sets of FORCE_PLATFORM corners in lab mm. Supplementary Table 2 code 12 assigns right plate 1 and left plate 2. Source local Fz1 down, lab +Z up.
variables.force: Scaled N at 1500 Hz. Fifteen consecutive samples centered on nominal camera time; chart uses the arithmetic mean of calibrated lab +Z.
variables.axes: Lab +X along the consecutive plates, Y across, +Z up. Right and left are from source side labels, not screen orientation.
variables.precision: No trial-specific uncertainty for these heel changes. Two-way filtering and reconstructed marker gaps preclude a live latency test.
